name: Langry RH20-A Mortar Rebound Hammer
short_description: Ultra-low impact energy (0.196 J) rebound hammer for evaluating compressive strength of masonry bed joint mortar and external wall plaster.
description: The **Langry RH20-A Mortar Rebound Hammer** (Type M) delivers an ultra-gentle impact energy of 0.196 Joules, making it the premier instrument for evaluating joint mortar and wall rendering in masonry buildings without damaging heritage brickwork.

key_features.feature: Type M ultra-low impact energy of 0.196 Joules
Measuring range for soft mortars: 1.0 to 25.0 MPa
Special tip radius for narrow masonry joint testing
Delicate spring system with 100 ± 5 N/m stiffness

seo_title: Langry RH20-A Mortar Rebound Hammer (0.196 J) | Accurion Technologies
